title: Genesis 18:13-14 — Birth Prophesied: Sarah will have a son
summary: Genesis 18:13-14: the LORD asks Abraham why Sarah laughed and promises that at this time next year Sarah will have a son. Colour-coded words (LORD, Abraham, Sarah, I, son) with the large caption 'Birth Prophesied'.

text.text: 13 And the LORD said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh,
saying, ‘Shall I indeed bear a child, when I am so old?’
14 “Is anything too difficult for the LORD?
At the appointed time I will return to you,
at this time next year, and Sarah will have a son.”

keywords: Is anything too difficult for the LORD
